newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan weekly forex reserves up at $1.35 bln.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan weekly forex reserves up at $1.35 bln.

text.p: Pakistan's foreign exchange reserves rose to $1.35 billion on November 7 from $1.26 billion a week earlier, but they were lower when compared to $1.91 billion on November 9, 1995, the State (central) Bank of Pakistan (SBP) said on Tuesday.
It gave no reason for the rise.

Bankers said higher remittances by overseas Pakistanis and foreign currency deposits by banks, brought in from abroad to benefit from a scheme offering higher profit and other concessions given last month, might have pushed the reserves up.
The reserves included $574 million within and $96 million outside Pakistan, an SBP statement said.
